title: Galvanic reaction: why yogurt tastes like a battery
caption:
That metallic zing? Your spoon just became a battery.
A cartoon guy happily spoons sour yogurt, gags like he licked a rusted battery, and a circuit-style infographic shows lightning zapping his tongue.
Yogurt's acid + your saliva turn the metal spoon into a micro-battery - a tiny galvanic current makes your taste buds taste metal, so swap to a wooden spoon.
Ever gotten that creepy metallic zing from a spoonful of yogurt?
Save this for your next yogurt run and follow for a new body-science fact every day.
